sql: WITH receita AS (SELECT ano_referencia, SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE dsc_cateconomica ILIKE '%Corrente%' AND ano_referencia BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024 GROUP BY ano_referencia), despesa AS (SELECT ano_referencia, SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM despesa_despesa WHERE dsc_naturezadespesa ILIKE '3%' AND ano_referencia BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024 GROUP BY ano_referencia) SELECT r.ano_referencia, (CAST(r.total_receita AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(d.total_despesa, 0)) AS isf_m FROM receita r JOIN despesa d ON r.ano_referencia = d.ano_referencia;
